note: Hand-painted cartoon faces, one per NPC, in the game's toon style. In-town faces are opaque 512x512 PNGs painted on the NPC's exact roster skin tone; welcome faces are transparent 512x512 overlays. Every face keeps the animated speaking-mouth zone clear of static features. Applied at runtime by assets/npc-faces.js; the faceArtwork fields in the roster manifests mirror these paths.
